q2_gaps: first-person pronoun 'we', and direct quotation with no reporting clause - the pronoun rule enumerates he/she/they-singular/plural-they/it only, and nothing covers speaker-deictic reference or quoted speech
proper-noun modifier of a common noun denoting affiliation - 'the (U.S.) occupation'; the parenthetical insertion itself is also unaddressed
notes: The But endpoints are correctly reified ('Saddam is gone' gives a state witness with Experiencer plus the flat copular atom), and 'want the occupation to end' takes the control-verb pattern with the occupation as the tenseless complement's Patient (change-of-state undergoer). Emitting no per-member distribution rule for the 'we' group is defensible, since predicating over the group as a unit is the stated default.
